capabilities: Import skill packages from local agent folders
Copy complete skill packages to agent targets
Check copies and preview file diffs
Retire copies whose source was removed
disambiguation: Not a skill runner or in-app AI assistant; it only copies skill packages to local agent folders.
extras: Desktop only, Obsidian 1.7.2 or newer. No network requests or telemetry; machine-local settings live in ~/.skill-switchboard/ and .skill-switchboard-status.json at vault root records local paths.
problem: Skills kept in Obsidian have to be copied by hand into each local agent's folder, and those copies drift with no check, diff or backup.
